cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to the god Kēśava at Lōmada by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Mahārāja. The village is stated to have been granted to the chief as amaramānyakara by the king. It is stated that the chief was the grandson of Naṇḍila Peda-Avubhaladēva and belonged to the Atreya-gōtra, Āpastamba-sūtra and Yajus-śākhā.

cells.place: Stone lying near the well called Peda-bāvi outside the village.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Contains only the imprecatory portion. In characters of about the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / PULIVENDLA TALUK · Toṇḍūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying in the dilapidated site of the Gōpālasvāmin temple outside the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Seems to refer to some gifts made by Timmarāju.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / PURRUR DIVISION · PURRUR DIVISION. Nagari — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Two fragments built in two different places in the Kara-kaṭhēśvara temple at Puḍupet.
cells.remarks: Records a provision made for burning a lamp in the temple of Karaikkandar of the village Kurichanchir by Danṭiyan, son of Araṇi, who was administering Paṅkara-nāḍu situated in Kuñravattana-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / PURRUR DIVISION · PURRUR DIVISION. Nagari † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tier of the eastern and northern walls of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to record the gift of a maḍai-viḷāgam at Nagari-agaram to the god Karaikkandīśvara by Krishṇarāyanāyaka.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / PURRUR DIVISION · PURRUR DIVISION. Nagari † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tier of the northern and western walls of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Commences with the prasasti, Pugalmādu, etc. Seems to record a provision made for the worship, etc., of the god Karaikkandīśvara by the resident of the town Mahipālakulakālapura (modern Nagari).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / PURRUR DIVISION · Puḍupet — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slabs built into the wall of the Kaṇḍīśvarasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Refers to the temple of Perumāḷ at Nagari.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / PURRUR DIVISION · Puḍupet † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Boulder in the stream near the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record an agreement reached on a dispute regarding the use of water of the two villages, Nagari and Mangāḍu, in the presence of the two officers, Viṭṭhōji Paṇḍita who was in charge of the Nagari division and Rāgōji-Paṇḍita of the Mangāḍu-nāḍu when Malatari Nilakaṇṭha ha Paṇḍita was the administrative head of the province under Rāma Koḷḷi Sāyubu, governor under the Kuṭubēhāhi king of Golkonda.

cells.location: MADRAS PROVINCE / CHITFOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR DIVISION · MADRAS PROVINCE—contd. / CHITFOOR DISTRICT—concld. / PUNGANUR DIVISION
cells.place: Maāchinillapalle.—(hamlet of Kottakōṭa). Stone lying on a well outside the village.
cells.remarks: Mentions Uttama-Chōla-gaṇḍarāyaṇ.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Iṣaiyānguđi.—Slab in a field called amMalīta-nāttaiyāl in the village.
cells.remarks: In late characters. Records the gift of a land as sarvamānya-un-bali free of kadamai to Sēku Magamad Sēku Sāyabu (Sheik Muhammad Sheik Saheb).

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK · Ilayānrādi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Four sides of a stone set-up in front of the Śiva temple by the side of a seated Jaina image.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost and portions damaged. Seems to record an endowment of land as pallichchandam for conducting worship and festivals in the temple of Bhagavatī-Nāyakar. Mention is made of Nārāyaṇayyan perumballi and a native of Ilānguṛi.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK · Śēlagrāmum — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jamb, pro-Pāṇḍya per right of entrance, Varaguṇīs-vara tēmplo.
cells.remarks: Tamil in Vatṭeĵuttu .

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK · Śēlagrāmum † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jamb, proper left of entrance, same tēmplc.
cells.remarks: States that the door frame was constructed by Vāsudēva-nārāyaṇan of Kōṭṭaiyūr.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK · Śēlagrāmum — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jamb, proper left of entrance, same tēmplc.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the village of Sālaigrāmam situated in Duvvūr-kūṇram alias Mayimākara-valanāđu as dēvadāna-brahmadēya to god Varaguṇa-lévara of the village, free of taxes. The gift is stated to have been made as per the royal order (śrimukha) of Perumāṇañigal Śrivalluvadēvar. The record is signed at the end by Vuiguṇaśiya Nakkaṇ.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAGUDI TALUK · Periyapattanam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab from the village now in the office of the Samasthanam Revenue officer, Ramnad.
cells.remarks: States that the stone marks the grave of Mariam, daughter of David, and contains a prayer for the peace of her soul.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / SRIVILLIPUTTUR TALUK · SRIVILLIPUTTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Ilandirakondān.—A stone set up in the tank bed of the village.
cells.remarks: Records the provision made for the annual dredging of the tank Maruturaṇerī out of its fish income by Nāraṇadeva Mudaliyār, the agent of Virappa-Nāyakkarayap-Kittappa-Nāyakkarayyan.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / SRIVILLIPUTTUR TALUK · Mīvairageṇrān — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jamb of the Marakatavalli shrine, Tirumalaikoṝduvāśara temple.
cells.remarks: Opening lines lost. Seems to record a grant of land on kāriyai-mat tenure to ten Brahmārthas after fixing the rates of duty in kind payable by them. The tenure was to take effect from the 3+5th year of the reign of king Kulaśēkhara. There are three more fragmentary inscribed slabs built into the walls of this temple. One of these seems to refer to certain gifts made in the year opposite the 5th of a king (name lost) and to Karunilakkudinaqu while the other two mention names of certain individuals.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Śākkōṭṭai.—East wall, mahāmaṇḍapa, proper right of entrance, Sōkeśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land free of taxes to the assembly (ūr) of Śākkōṭṭai situated in Perumbarru-nādu, a sub-division of Kēraļasiṅga-vaļanādu, to Vīran Sīrāvyaṇ Anantankharan achāri of the village for (having constructed) the tank and steps for the tirumañjanam (bathing ceremony) of god Viraśēkharīśvaramudaiyār.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · TIRUPPATTUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: States that Periyanāyan Āḷagan Gāngēyan granted a piece of land, after purchase, as karāṇmai, free of taxes, to god Vira-śēkarīśvaramuļaiya Mahādēva for the expenses of conducting the Manavāļaṇ-sandhi.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Records the order (ōlai) of Gāngēyan granting a field in Vīśu-lūr for the expenses of worship and offerings to the deity, Vikrama-Vija-Pāļiyar (i.e., Gaṇapati), set up by him.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: States that aļļanarai Vīrapperumāļ, granted to god Viraśēkhara all the fields, etc., of the villages of Śāyakkallar and Kaņlānūr for meeting the expenses of the festivals on days of Uttarādam.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · TIRUPPATTUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, proper left of entrance
cells.date: 18th year, Kanni, śu. 10, Monday; Tiruvõṇāyam=A. D. 1256, September 3, Monday; -02, 60.
cells.remarks: Records that the assembly (ūr) of Śāyakkalkūr sold the village of Mummudi-sōjaṇ after making it free of taxes to the temple of Tiruvēdakhava-īśvaramudaiyār for a sum of 200 paṇam. This inscription is a record of the sale of the land by the temple authorities by the sale of the ornaments of the gods to one Aļigamēndēvar, a tiruvalal-mādal of the king's household.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall, same mandapa
cells.king: Tribhuvanachakravartin Sundara-Pāndyadēva who was pleased to present the Chōla country.
cells.remarks: Registers the order (ōlai) of Gāṅgaiyan assigning the taxes from the village of Vīraśōlanallūr for meeting the expenses of the festivals to be conducted in the temple on the days of Tiruzādirai which was the natal star of the chief.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Seems to register the order of Gāṅgaiyan pertaining to the sale of curtain lands to the temple.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions god Viraśēkharīsvaramudaiyār.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land as kuḍikāṅgā-dēva-dāna to the god.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of land to meet the expense of offerings and services to the god during the Śivarātri festivals by Abhaya-Pāndyan Virudarājabhayankara Adalaiyūrmān-ālvān.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Completely damaged after the king's name.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door-jamb, proper right, same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: States that the maṇḍapa was called Māṇavasīgan-tirumam-dapam.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall, mahāmaṇḍapa
cells.remarks: Seems to record an endowment of land and money to the god by Alagangaṇḍan alias Gāṅgaiyan. Signed by Kuru-kulattaraiyan.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Fragment of stone built into the same wall.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Sōjakon and several other persons. Below the inscription is engraved another record of the reign of Vīra-Pāndya mentioning a gift of land.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that the assemblies of the village and nāḍu of Śāykkuḍi granted the village of Siriyūr, free of taxes, to Bhavārichāriyār Dakshiṇāmūrttisvāmi a resident of Śāykkuḍi, to the south of the Tirunelvēliyāgnīśvaram or Tirunattamadaiuḍaiya-Nāyinar at Mīļamvarāttipattinam in Pāṇḍināḍu.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Fragment of stone built into the wall.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to mention Vikrama-Pāṇḍya and Kulōttuṅgajoļa Aiyadaramāṇaiyan and records a gift of land to the temple of Vīra Sēkharasīvaram.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On five fragments built into the same wall.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to an endowment of land as tiruviļakkuppappu to the temple for maintaining lamps. Also records a separate gift of land to the god, Piļļaiyār. Among the signatories to the gift were Pallavaraiyar, Gāṅgaiyaraiyan and Iruṅgōlan.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a gift made by Parākrama- Pāṇḍya to the god for offerings and worship on the day of Ani-Avilam, which was his natal star. For this purpose he instituted the festival called Parākrama-Pāṇḍyanandī.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall, same maṇḍapa
cells.king: Māravarman Tribhuvanachakravartin Kulasēkharadēva who was pleased to take every country'.
cells.remarks: States that the tānattār of the temple of Vīrachākramudaiyār granted to Uḍaiyappillai Tambirānkōlar a piece of land as tiruvanandapuram specifying the dues payable by him in kind.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, proper right of entrance
cells.king: Māravarman Tribhuvanachakravartin Kulasēkharadēva who was pleased to take every country'.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land as kudīniṅgākāni by Gāṅgāyar for providing offerings and worship to the deity Tiruvidināchchiyār-ālīvār set up by Kaṇdan Nāchchiyār, his granddaughter.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner west wall, Naṭarāja shrine, mahāmaṇdapa.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a gift of land as kīrāgmasi, free of taxes by Yādavarāyaṇ.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar inside the same mandapa
cells.remarks: States that the pillar called Śittirazandak-kāl was the gift of Paramānandadēvan of Kulattūr belonging to Virapāṇdyapuram. Two other pillars in the same mandapa contain inscriptions stating that they were the gift of Vēngāvayalār.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall. ardhamandapa, same temple.
cells.date: Šaka 1376 (in words), Bhāva, Paṅguni, Mīna, šu. 5, Monday, Hastā. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Damaged after the date. Seems to mention a donation by Parākrama-Pāṇdya Viśaiyālaiyadēvaṇ.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall, céntral shrine, same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to Virasēkharamudaiya-Tambirān by Vayiravanāyiṇār Viśaiyālaiyadēvaṇ, son of Paļļikonṣa-Viśaiyālaiyadēvaṇ, a chief of Šūraikkuđi.

cells.location: MADRAS PROVINCE / RAMNAI DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · MADRAS PROVINCE—contd. / RAMNAI DISTRICT—concld. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK—concld. — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Damaged. States that the village of Iḍaikkakkudi was granted to gol Tiruttalūra-Nāyaṇār of Tiruppattūr by Veṅgaḷa-Nāyaṇkar, son of Tiruvēṅgaḷa-Nāyaṇkar. Mentions a chief of Paṇṭakuḷi.

cells.location: MADRAS PROVINCE / RAMNAI DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · • TANJORE DISTRICT MANNARGUDI TALUK Pūvaṇūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall, ardha-maṇḍapa, proper left of entrance, Chataraṅgavallabhaṇṭhūva-miu temple.
cells.date: .... Māgha, śa. Amāvāsya, Saturday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land made by the king in the presence of god Virūpākṣa.

cells.location: MADRAS PROVINCE / RAMNAI DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift to Brāhmaṇas of various gōtras and sūtras.

cells.location: MADRAS PROVINCE / RAMNAI DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of the same maṇḍapa and north wall of the central shrine.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions names of several donees. Probably connected with other No. 63 or 64 above.

cells.location: MADRAS PROVINCE / RAMNAI DISTRICT / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-contd. / TIRUPPATTUR TALUK-contd. / Sakkottai-contd. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall, ardhamanḍapa, same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Tiruppuvanūr.

cells.place: Slab built into the south wall, same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions Rājāśēkharahārāja.

cells.place: North wall, central shrine, same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and continuation lost. Mentions Peṇṇakaḷam-uḍaiyār and Tiruchchirrambalam-uḍaiyār.
